summary: @qlik/sprout-design-docs preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle
details: The package advertises itself as design-system documentation for the Qlik sprout family and ships a Storybook/MDX scaffold, but package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` which fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style (identifiers `_0x488df8`, per-call scrambled string maps) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, "math_init.js")], { stdio: "inherit", cwd: D })` against a 727KB obfuscated sibling bundle `math_init.js` (large rotating string-array, hex-numeric constants). Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-only inspection. The documentation content and the install-time payload are unrelated; a docs package has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate runtime and execute a large obfuscated bundle at install time. The shape is consistent with a maintainer-account compromise or hijack of the @qlik/sprout family.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
